items.question: What form of mantra and fuel-sticks is prescribed for the fire oblation?
premises: Dry fuel-sticks are the objects to be offered.
The offering is performed as a ritual oblation.
The mantra to be uttered must end with svāhā.
items.inference: One should offer dry fuel-sticks into the fire while uttering a mantra ending in svāhā.
uncertainties: The specific mantra is not named in this verse and may depend on the preceding ritual context.
items.plain_english: Dry fuel-sticks are to be offered while one utters a mantra that ends with svāhā.
